title: Reflexive Descent to Minimal Seeds in the Kreuzer–Skarke List: code, data and checks
description:
Code, data and independent checks for the paper Reflexive Descent to Minimal Seeds in the Kreuzer–Skarke List by Deep Bhattacharjee and Ushashi Bhattacharya.

A reflexive polytope inside another is a cover when no reflexive polytope lies between them, and a reflexive descent is a chain of covers that ends at an r-minimal polytope. The paper proves that every reflexive polytope has such a descent and that it ends above a minimal seed; that in dimension four no descent has more than 348 steps, so that the conjecture of a uniform transition depth holds with D = 349; that the largest transition depths in dimensions two and three are 5 and 11; and that the largest four-dimensional polytope, the simplex with 680 lattice points, has transition depth at most 36. The exact maximum in dimension four is open.

The archive holds the joint distribution of lattice point counts of the 473,800,776 four-dimensional reflexive polytopes and their duals, the pair bound with a longest chain, the cover relation of the 16 polygons and the 4,319 three-dimensional polytopes, the descent of the 680-point simplex with the certificate of every step, the programs that computed them, and 68 independent checks: a C program for the pair bound, a C++ program for the 680-point simplex and its dual, Python checks of the pair bound, the descent and the three-dimensional depths, a Julia enumeration of the polygons from scratch, a Macaulay2 check with the Polyhedra package, and 18 Lean 4 theorems on the finite arithmetic and the counting lemma, each axiom-free or depending on propext only. code/run_checks.sh runs them all.
